literal: The provinces and commanderies that formerly memorialized the Minister of Works should all now memorialize the Chancellor's office for implementation; warrants and notices are likewise.
idiomatic: The provinces and commanderies that formerly memorialized the Minister of Works should all now memorialize the chancellor's office for implementation; warrants and notices are likewise.

literal: " Day jiaxu, an edict stated: "To select the multitude and raise them up is an ancient practice.
idiomatic: " On jiaxu day an edict stated: "To select the multitude and raise them up is an ancient practice.

literal: I succeed to the great enterprise and govern the myriad affairs, seeking the worthy to bring order—my heart is as thirsty as if parched.
idiomatic: I succeed to the great enterprise and govern the myriad affairs, seeking the worthy to bring order—my heart is as thirsty as if parched.

literal: To know men is wisdom; it has been hard since antiquity. Broad inquiry should be made of dukes and ministers to gather true reputation.
idiomatic: To know men is wisdom; it has been hard since antiquity. Broad inquiry should be made of dukes and ministers to gather true reputation.

literal: From rank one down to rank five and above, each man should recommend those he knows, without limiting commoners or officeholders.
idiomatic: From rank one down to rank five and above, each man should recommend those he knows, without limiting commoners or officeholders.

literal: They must clearly state talent and arts and fully note what each can do; then, according to the memorial, select and promote, receiving office as talent warrants, so that the abundance of excellence may not fall short of former times and upright integrity may find scope this year."
idiomatic: They must clearly state talent and arts and fully note what each can do; then, according to the memorial, select and promote, receiving office as talent warrants, so that the abundance of excellence may not fall short of former times and upright integrity may find scope this year."

literal: Xiao Yan sent Chief Clerk of North Liang Province Xi Xiuru, Marshal Yu He, and Administrator of Shangyong Jiang Pingluo and others to invade Zhicheng; Inspector of Liang Province Fu Shuyan sent his son Jingshao to lead troops to resist; they were greatly defeated and more than three thousand were captured and beheaded;
idiomatic: Xiao Yan sent Xi Xiuru, chief clerk of North Liang Province, Yu He, marshal, and Jiang Pingluo, administrator of Shangyong, and others to invade Zhicheng; Fu Shuyan, inspector of Liang Province, sent his son Jingshao to lead troops to resist; they were greatly defeated and more than three thousand were captured and beheaded;

literal: Xiuru and the others fled back to Weixing.
idiomatic: Xiuru and the others fled back to Weixing.

literal: That month: the people of Qinghe in Qi Province, Cui Xu, killed Administrator Dong Zun; the people of Guangchuan, Fu Dui, seized Administrator Liu Mang and rebelled.
idiomatic: That month the people of Qinghe in Qi Province, Cui Xu, killed Administrator Dong Zun; the people of Guangchuan, Fu Dui, seized Administrator Liu Mang and rebelled.

literal: Inspector of Qing Province and Prince of Anle Jian suppressed and pacified them.
idiomatic: Jian, inspector of Qing Province and prince of Anle, suppressed and pacified them.

literal: That month: the separate commander of Po Luhan Baling, Wang Ye Bulu, and others took Huai Shuo Garrison.
idiomatic: That month the separate commander of Po Luhan Baling, Wang Ye Bulu, and others took Huai Shuo Garrison.

literal: Fourth month of summer: Xiao Yan's Inspector of Yi Province Xiao Yuanyou sent generals Fan Wenchao and Xiao Shicheng and others to besiege Little Sword Garrison.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer Xiao Yan's inspector of Yi Province Xiao Yuanyou sent generals Fan Wenchao and Xiao Shicheng and others to besiege Little Sword Garrison.

literal: Inspector of Yi Province Bing Chou sent his son Zida; the mobile office Wei Zijian sent separate commander Chunyu Dan to resist and attack them.
idiomatic: Bing Chou, inspector of Yi Province, sent his son Zida; Wei Zijian, mobile office director, sent separate commander Chunyu Dan to resist and attack them.

literal: Day xinmao: the empress dowager again attended court and held regency, summoning the ministers to state gains and losses face to face.
idiomatic: On xinmao day the empress dowager again attended court and held regency, summoning the ministers to state gains and losses face to face.

literal: An edict stated: "I, small and dim, from youth have inherited the heavenly succession; I am as if crossing the sea, not knowing how to reach the shore. I truly rely on the spirits of the altars of soil and grain for their lowering protection, hoping to fulfill my young resolve and bring peace to the age.
idiomatic: An edict stated: "I, small and dim, from youth have inherited the heavenly succession; I am as if crossing the sea, not knowing how to reach the shore. I truly rely on the spirits of the altars of soil and grain for their lowering protection, hoping to fulfill my young resolve and bring peace to the age.

literal: At the end of the Divine Tortoise era powerful ministers usurped command; Yuan Cha and Liu Teng secretly influenced each other, so that the empress dowager was shut away in the rear palace, the Grand Tutor and Prince of Qinghe were killed without crime, Inspector of Xiang Province and Prince of Zhongshan Xi was wantonly destroyed, and Right Guard General Xi Kangsheng was likewise executed.
idiomatic: At the end of the Divine Tortoise era powerful ministers usurped command; Yuan Cha and Liu Teng secretly influenced each other, so that the empress dowager was shut away in the rear palace, the grand tutor and prince of Qinghe were killed without crime, Xi, inspector of Xiang Province and prince of Zhongshan, was wantonly destroyed, and Xi Kangsheng, right guard general, was likewise executed.

literal: From then on they feared nothing, wantonly made demands, and at their posts seized and granted as they pleased.
idiomatic: From then on they feared nothing, wantonly made demands, and at their posts seized and granted as they pleased.

literal: The heart without a lord accumulated over long habit;
idiomatic: The heart without a lord accumulated over long habit;

literal: the traces of disloyalty grew plainer with each affair.
idiomatic: the traces of disloyalty grew plainer with each affair.

literal: They blocked the brightness of eyes and ears and monopolized the power of life and death; the realm was thereby unquiet and the four marches grew full of ramparts.
idiomatic: They blocked the brightness of eyes and ears and monopolized the power of life and death; the realm was thereby unquiet and the four marches grew full of ramparts.

literal: If this can be borne, what cannot be borne in the heart!
idiomatic: If this can be borne, what cannot be borne in the heart!

literal: Though they were repeatedly pardoned and not yet handed to the law, they should still be judged and corrected to answer court and realm.
idiomatic: Though they were repeatedly pardoned and not yet handed to the law, they should still be judged and corrected to answer court and realm.

literal: Teng being already gone, his rank may be posthumously stripped.
idiomatic: Teng being already gone, his rank may be posthumously stripped.

literal: Cha's crimes truly merit the cord, but because he is of the imperial clan and a maternal relative, special full pardon is granted; he may be removed from the registers and made a commoner."
idiomatic: Cha's crimes truly merit the cord, but because he is of the imperial clan and a maternal relative, special full pardon is granted; he may be removed from the registers and made a commoner."

literal: Day renchen: General Who Campaigns West and Commander Cui Yanbo was greatly defeated on the Jing River and died in battle.
idiomatic: On renchen day Yanbo, general who campaigns west and commander, was greatly defeated on the Jing River and died in battle.

literal: Fifth month, day wuchen: Chunyu Dan and others greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army; captives and heads numbered in the tens of thousands; eleven generals including Xiao Shicheng were captured; Wenchao barely escaped with his life and fled to Chengdu.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuchen day, Chunyu Dan and others greatly defeated Xiao Yan's army; captives and heads numbered in the tens of thousands; eleven generals including Xiao Shicheng were captured; Wenchao barely escaped with his life and fled to Chengdu.

literal: Day wuzi, [12] Grand General Who Conquers on Horseback and Bearer of the Triple Staff Li Chong died.
idiomatic: On wuzi day, [12] Li Chong, grand general who conquers on horseback and bearer of the triple staff, died.

literal: Sixth month, day guiwei: a general amnesty; the era name was changed.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on guiwei day, a general amnesty was proclaimed; the era name was changed.

literal: An edict ordered that civil and military officials who had followed the army two hundred days should receive one grade of promotion for civil officials and two for military officials.
idiomatic: An edict ordered that civil and military officials who had followed the army two hundred days should receive one grade of promotion for civil officials and two for military officials.

literal: The Rouran ruler Anagui led his horde and greatly defeated Baling, beheading his generals Kongque and others.
idiomatic: The Rouran ruler Anagui led his horde and greatly defeated Baling, beheading his generals Kongque and others.

literal: The generals pressed Pengcheng; Xiao Zong slipped out by night and surrendered; Xiao Yan's generals fled in retreat; the armies pursued—only one or two in ten escaped.
idiomatic: The generals pressed Pengcheng; Xiao Zong slipped out by night and surrendered; Xiao Yan's generals fled in retreat; the armies pursued—only one or two in ten escaped.

literal: Eighth month of autumn, day guiyou: an edict forbade tribute of rare luxuries from near and far; violators were removed from office.
idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on guiyou day, an edict forbade tribute of rare luxuries from near and far; violators were removed from office.

literal: The people of Rouxuan Garrison, Du Luozhou, gathered a crowd and rebelled at Shanggu, styled their era True King, overran commanderies and counties, and besieged Yan Province from the south.
idiomatic: The people of Rouxuan Garrison, Du Luozhou, gathered a crowd and rebelled at Shanggu, styled their era True King, overran commanderies and counties, and besieged Yan Province from the south.

literal: Day wuzi: Moqi Niansheng sent commanders Du Hei'er and Du Guang and others to attack Qiuchi commandery.
idiomatic: On wuzi day Moqi Niansheng sent commanders Du Hei'er and Du Guang and others to attack Qiuchi commandery.

literal: Wei Zijian of the mobile office sent General Cheng Qian to defeat them and beheaded Guang.
idiomatic: Wei Zijian of the mobile office sent General Cheng Qian to defeat them and beheaded Guang.

literal: Ninth month, day yimao: an edict reduced all levies throughout the realm by half.
idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yimao day, an edict reduced all levies throughout the realm by half.

literal: [13] Day bingchen: an edict made Left General and Inspector of You Province Chang Jing mobile office commander and General Who Campaigns against Barbarians Yuan Tan commander, to attack Luozhou.
idiomatic: [13] On bingchen day an edict made Chang Jing, left general and inspector of You Province, mobile office commander and Yuan Tan, general who campaigns against barbarians, commander, to attack Luozhou.

literal: Day xinyou, an edict stated: "Pursuing merit and displaying virtue encourages the good.
idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict stated: "Pursuing merit and displaying virtue encourages the good.

literal: Meritorious ministers of the ancestors were inscribed in the princely mansion, yet their descendants fell into neglect and sank among commoners; rank and title were unknown and their lines wandered in loss.
idiomatic: Meritorious ministers of the ancestors were inscribed in the princely mansion, yet their descendants fell into neglect and sank among commoners; rank and title were unknown and their lines wandered in loss.

literal: Famous governors of Yingchuan, magistrates of Chongquan—their gracious winds and fine government bound the hearts of the people—yet they still ranked as ordinary and received no exalted promotion; this is not what is meant by cherishing the sweet pear or putting constant order in the norms.
idiomatic: Famous governors of Yingchuan, magistrates of Chongquan—their gracious winds and fine government bound the hearts of the people—yet they still ranked as ordinary and received no exalted promotion; this is not what is meant by cherishing the sweet pear or putting constant order in the norms.

literal: Meritorious generals known to former courts whose descendants are cramped and not enrolled, and prefects, governors, magistrates, and chancellors of outstanding reputation—all should be reported by name to the relevant offices.
idiomatic: Meritorious generals known to former courts whose descendants are cramped and not enrolled, and prefects, governors, magistrates, and chancellors of outstanding reputation—all should be reported by name to the relevant offices.

literal: I shall raise those sunk in obscurity and spread the wind of good government."
idiomatic: I shall raise those sunk in obscurity and spread the wind of good government."

literal: Day renxu: an edict ordered all officials of rank five and above each to recommend those they knew.
idiomatic: On renxu day an edict ordered all officials of rank five and above each to recommend those they knew.

literal: Day xinwei: a partial amnesty for South and North Qin provinces.
idiomatic: On xinwei day a partial amnesty was proclaimed for South and North Qin provinces.

literal: Tenth month of winter: the Rouran ruler Anagui sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter the Rouran ruler Anagui sent envoys with tribute.

literal: That month: Tuyuhun again attacked Zhao Tianan and made him surrender.
idiomatic: That month Tuyuhun again attacked Zhao Tianan and made him surrender.

literal: Chief Clerk of He Province Yuan Yongping and Administrator Meng Bin and others installed the Hephthalite envoy-lord Gao Hui to act as provincial governor; the former inspector Liang Zhao's son Jingjin attacked and killed him; Jingjin then acted as provincial governor himself.
idiomatic: Yuan Yongping, chief clerk of He Province, and Meng Bin, administrator, and others installed the Hephthalite envoy-lord Gao Hui to act as provincial governor; Jingjin, son of the former inspector Liang Zhao, attacked and killed him; Jingjin then acted as provincial governor himself.

literal: Eleventh month, day xinhai, an edict stated: "Great filial piety honors kin; this is set out in ancient canons. Hence the peace of Ping in old age filled the court with sons.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on xinhai day, an edict stated: "Great filial piety honors kin; this is set out in ancient canons. Hence the peace of Ping in old age filled the court with sons.

literal: From now on, all whose parents are eighty or more may be allowed to hold office and receive salary to support them, warm in court morning and evening."
idiomatic: From now on, all whose parents are eighty or more may be allowed to hold office and receive salary to support them, warm in court morning and evening."

literal: At that time affairs were many on all sides and the various Man rebelled again.
idiomatic: At that time affairs were many on all sides and the various Man rebelled again.

literal: Twelfth month, day renwu, an edict stated: "Gaozu by great clarity fixed merit; Shizong by martial power settled disorder—fame overflowed north and south, transformation cleared the central realm; the enterprise rivaled prosperous Zhou and the throne extended seven hundred years.
idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renwu day, an edict stated: "Gaozu by great clarity fixed merit; Shizong by martial power settled disorder—fame overflowed north and south, transformation cleared the central realm; the enterprise rivaled prosperous Zhou and the throne extended seven hundred years.

literal: I, young in years, succeeded to the calendar; from youth I have driven the great foundation, fearful and cautious as if standing over an abyss.
idiomatic: I, young in years, succeeded to the calendar; from youth I have driven the great foundation, fearful and cautious as if standing over an abyss.

literal: Dim in the way of government, punishments and grace not yet won, powerful ministers usurped command and disturbed our court pattern.
idiomatic: Dim in the way of government, punishments and grace not yet won, powerful ministers usurped command and disturbed our court pattern.

literal: They caused West Qin to run riot, the northern desert to breed demons, and the stupid Man of Jing to seethe without cease.
idiomatic: They caused West Qin to run riot, the northern desert to breed demons, and the stupid Man of Jing to seethe without cease.

literal: The peril exceeded Jingyang; raising armies was as urgent as Xiliu.
idiomatic: The peril exceeded Jingyang; raising armies was as urgent as Xiliu.

literal: Yet the armies lingered and did not advance; the northern ford hung in peril and Nanyang cried urgent alarm—lands of Jing and Mian were about to be lost and the state brought to crushing grief.
idiomatic: Yet the armies lingered and did not advance; the northern ford hung in peril and Nanyang cried urgent alarm—lands of Jing and Mian were about to be lost and the state brought to crushing grief.

literal: Now the thatched carriage wrings its wrists and claws and fangs sigh in anger; all wish to break the great boar and cut the long serpent, so that man and spirit are both at peace and the hidden and manifest offer good omens.
idiomatic: Now the thatched carriage wrings its wrists and claws and fangs sigh in anger; all wish to break the great boar and cut the long serpent, so that man and spirit are both at peace and the hidden and manifest offer good omens.

literal: I shall personally drive the Six Armies and sweep away the fleeing filth.
idiomatic: I shall personally drive the Six Armies and sweep away the fleeing filth.

literal: Those assigned to the Six Armies, divided under bear and tiger, vanguard and rear, left wing and right division—generals and commanders must be bold and resolute, staff officers clear and able; grain, weapons, chariots, and horses must be ready when needed.
idiomatic: Those assigned to the Six Armies, divided under bear and tiger, vanguard and rear, left wing and right division—generals and commanders must be bold and resolute, staff officers clear and able; grain, weapons, chariots, and horses must be ready when needed.

literal: Those who lost discipline and perished in battle, soldiers and garrisons who fled, bandits and raiders hiding in mountains and marshes—their past faults are forgiven and later merit recorded; separate recruitment standards are set, they may renew themselves, and orders are sent broadly to provinces and commanderies to come to the army rendezvous.
idiomatic: Those who lost discipline and perished in battle, soldiers and garrisons who fled, bandits and raiders hiding in mountains and marshes—their past faults are forgiven and later merit recorded; separate recruitment standards are set, they may renew themselves, and orders are sent broadly to provinces and commanderies to come to the army rendezvous.

literal: First attack the Man of Jing and settle the southern marches;
idiomatic: First attack the Man of Jing and settle the southern marches;

literal: banners and spears point east to sweep the Huai region.
idiomatic: banners and spears point east to sweep the Huai region.

literal: then rouse the seven hosts on the western barbarians and gallop the five oxen against the northern Di;
idiomatic: then rouse the seven hosts on the western barbarians and gallop the five oxen against the northern Di;

literal: personally soothe the suffering of the displaced and face to face comfort the hungry and cold.
idiomatic: personally soothe the suffering of the displaced and face to face comfort the hungry and cold.

literal: then return to halt at Song heights, drink to the end at the temple court, sink the jade disk in He and Luo, and report completion at Mount Tai—how glorious!"
idiomatic: then return to halt at Song heights, drink to the end at the temple court, sink the jade disk in He and Luo, and report completion at Mount Tai—how glorious!"

literal: All civil and military officials within and without, governors and army commanders, should each be diligent and clarify their duties."
idiomatic: All civil and military officials within and without, governors and army commanders, should each be diligent and clarify their duties."

literal: The mountain Hu Liu Lisheng rebelled, styled himself Son of Heaven, and established officials.
idiomatic: The mountain Hu Liu Lisheng rebelled, styled himself Son of Heaven, and established officials.

literal: That month: Prince of Huaiyang Yu was made General Who Campaigns South and led troops to attack the Man of Luyang.
idiomatic: That month Yu, prince of Huaiyang, was made general who campaigns south and led troops to attack the Man of Luyang.

literal: Second month, day jiashen: the emperor and empress dowager attended the Great Summer Gate and personally reviewed wrongful suits.
idiomatic: In the second month, on jiashen day, the emperor and empress dowager attended the Great Summer Gate and personally reviewed wrongful suits.

literal: That month: the state of Diefuoluo sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: That month the state of Diefuoluo sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Third month, day gengzi: Prince of Anfeng Yanming, Grand General Who Conquers on Horseback and Inspector of Xuzhou, was made Bearer of the Triple Staff.
idiomatic: In the third month, on gengzi day, Yanming, prince of Anfeng, grand general who conquers on horseback and inspector of Xuzhou, was made bearer of the triple staff.

literal: Prince of Zhongshan Xi's original rank was posthumously restored; his son Shuren succeeded him.
idiomatic: Xi, prince of Zhongshan's original rank was posthumously restored; his son Shuren succeeded him.

literal: Day jiayin: the western Tiele Huluoyang rebelled at Sanggan and linked with the herdsmen of Hexi to the west.
idiomatic: On jiayin day the western Tiele Huluoyang rebelled at Sanggan and linked with the herdsmen of Hexi to the west.

literal: Separate commander Erzhu Rong defeated them.
idiomatic: Separate commander Erzhu Rong defeated them.

literal: Fourth month of summer: a general amnesty throughout the realm.
idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

literal: Day guisi: Palace Attendant, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and Prince of Chengyang Hui was made Bearer of the Triple Staff.
idiomatic: On guisi day Hui, palace attendant, general of chariots and cavalry, and prince of Chengyang, was made bearer of the triple staff.

literal: The people of Shuozhou, Xianyu Ahu and Kudifengle, seized the city and rebelled.
idiomatic: The people of Shuozhou, Xianyu Ahu and Kudifengle, seized the city and rebelled.

literal: Day dingwei: Commander Li Ju halted north of Ji city and was again defeated by Luozhou; Ju died in battle.
idiomatic: On dingwei day Commander Li Ju halted north of Ji city and was again defeated by Luozhou; Ju died in battle.

literal: Day wushen: Prince of Qi Baoyu, Grand General Who Conquers on Horseback and Opener of the Office, was made Bearer of the Triple Staff.
idiomatic: On wushen day Baoyu, prince of Qi, grand general who conquers on horseback and opener of the office, was made bearer of the triple staff.

literal: Northern campaign commanders Prince of Hejian Chen and Changsun Zhi were defeated and fled back; an edict removed Chen and Zhi from office and rank.
idiomatic: Northern campaign commanders Chen, prince of Hejian, and Changsun Zhi were defeated and fled back; an edict removed Chen and Zhi from office and rank.

literal: The state of Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.
idiomatic: The state of Kumo Xi sent envoys with tribute.

literal: Fifth month, day dingwei: the imperial carriage was about to campaign north; within and without were placed on alert.
idiomatic: In the fifth month, on dingwei day, the imperial carriage was about to campaign north; within and without were placed on alert.

literal: Former attendant gentleman of the yellow gate Yuan Lue returned from Xiao Yan and was enfeoffed as Prince of Yiyang.
idiomatic: Former attendant gentleman of the yellow gate Yuan Lue returned from Xiao Yan and was enfeoffed as prince of Yiyang.

literal: Chancellor and Prince of Gaoyang Yong was made Grand Marshal;
idiomatic: Yong, chancellor and prince of Gaoyang, was made grand marshal;

literal: Minister of Personnel and Prince of Guangyang Yuan was made Grand General Who Conquers on Horseback and Bearer of the Triple Staff, and soon grand commander, leading Commander and Prince of Zhangwu Rong on the northern campaign against Xiuli.
idiomatic: Yuan, minister of personnel and prince of Guangyang, was made grand general who conquers on horseback and bearer of the triple staff, and soon grand commander, leading Rong, commander and prince of Zhangwu, on the northern campaign against Xiuli.

literal: Day wushen: Inspector of Yan Province Cui Bing led troops, abandoned the city, and fled south to Zhongshan.
idiomatic: On wushen day Cui Bing, inspector of Yan Province, led troops, abandoned the city, and fled south to Zhongshan.

literal: Day yichou: General Who Pacifies the West and Household Minister Zhen Sun was made commander to attack the rebel Hu of Fen Province.
idiomatic: On yichou day Zhen Sun, general who pacifies the west and household minister, was made commander to attack the rebel Hu of Fen Province.

literal: Sixth month, day jisi: a partial amnesty for Qi Province.
idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jisi day, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for Qi Province.

literal: Chen Shuangchi of Jiangshu gathered a crowd and rebelled, styling himself King of Shijian.
idiomatic: Chen Shuangchi of Jiangshu gathered a crowd and rebelled, styling himself King of Shijian.

literal: A partial amnesty for the three commanderies of Pingyang, Jianxing, and Zhengping.
idiomatic: A partial amnesty was proclaimed for the three commanderies of Pingyang, Jianxing, and Zhengping.

literal: An edict made acting General Who Pacifies the West and Commander Changsun Zhi attack Shuangchi and pacify them.
idiomatic: An edict made Zhi, acting general who pacifies the west and commander, attack Shuangchi and pacify them.

literal: Day bingzi: Prince of Yiyang Lue was changed to Prince of Dongping.
idiomatic: On bingzi day Lue, prince of Yiyang, was changed to prince of Dongping.

literal: Grand General of the Guard and Western Route Commander Yuan Hengzhi was made General of Chariots and Cavalry and Bearer of the Triple Staff.
idiomatic: Hengzhi, grand general of the guard and western route commander, was made general of chariots and cavalry and bearer of the triple staff.

literal: Day wuyin: an edict restored Prince of Jingzhao Ji to his original fief as Prince of Jiangyang.
idiomatic: On wuyin day an edict restored Ji, prince of Jingzhao, to his original fief as prince of Jiangyang.

literal: Day wuzi, an edict stated: "Since fortune turned harsh, years have piled up here; beacons and posts race in relay and banners and drums never cease—the ancestors' great enterprise hangs by a thread, the altars' foundation nearly falls.
idiomatic: On wuzi day an edict stated: "Since fortune turned harsh, years have piled up here; beacons and posts race in relay and banners and drums never cease—the ancestors' great enterprise hangs by a thread, the altars' foundation nearly falls.

literal: My majesty cannot reach far; strategy cannot extend afar—how can I rest easy in the yellow canopy and face the black-haired people without shame?
idiomatic: My majesty cannot reach far; strategy cannot extend afar—how can I rest easy in the yellow canopy and face the black-haired people without shame?

literal: Now I withdraw to the main hall and take plain food and simple dress.
idiomatic: Now I withdraw to the main hall and take plain food and simple dress.

literal: I shall personally recruit and gather the loyal and brave.
idiomatic: I shall personally recruit and gather the loyal and brave.

literal: Those who speak straight and remonstrate, men daring to die for righteousness—on the twenty-fifth day all shall assemble at the east gate of Hualin; each will be received separately to discuss gains and losses together.
idiomatic: Those who speak straight and remonstrate, men daring to die for righteousness—on the twenty-fifth day all shall assemble at the east gate of Hualin; each will be received separately to discuss gains and losses together.

literal: Proclaim within and without so all may hear."
idiomatic: Proclaim within and without so all may hear."
